pages.text: $(thing)Fixed Points$()$(br2)Where a system stops changing: an equilibrium. Newton found them by guessing, then sliding down the tangent, again and again.

$(thing)Insight$(): 70$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Rates as Equations, Chemical Equilibrium.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 1 Rate Table.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): To find the square root of a, guess x, then average x with a/x. Write the better guess X.
